server.name: blitz-api
server.title: Blitz API
server.description: Find and enrich B2B people, companies and job postings: search people by title, seniority and location, find work emails and phone numbers, enrich companies and break down their headcount, build target-company lists, and search the Blitz documentation.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Blitz | B2B people, company, and jobs data, plus the Blitz documentation. Two tool groups: 'docs_*' tools search and read the Blitz docs (learn how); the rest call the Blitz REST API (do it). Unsure which endpoint or parameters to use? Call docs_search first, then the matching API tool. Prefer using docs_* to build a Python/JS script that fetches and enriches data to a local destination over large direct API-tool calls, which return big payloads that fill context. The 'Blitz usage guide' and 'Using the Blitz MCP' skills are available as resources. API tools are named by what they return: 'people_*' find and enrich people, 'company_*' find and enrich companies (including TAM and headcount distribution), 'job_*' search job postings, then account/util meta tools. Each API tool maps to one Blitz REST endpoint. API calls are authenticated, rate-limited, and metered per your API key, and use records from your plan's fair-usage allowance as stated in each tool's description; docs tools use no records. Authenticate by sending your Blitz API key in the 'x-api-key' request header, or sign in with OAuth when your MCP client supports it ('Authorization: Bearer <access token>'). The Bearer [redacted] does not accept an API key. Search tools paginate in one of three ways: most take 'max_results' and a 'cursor' you send back until it is null, 'people_employee_finder' takes a 'page' number instead, and 'people_waterfall_icp' answers in one shot. Every search also has a depth ceiling: 50,000 records for the people, company and TAM searches, 5,000 for jobs, 10,000 for 'people_employee_finder'. The page that hits it looks like a clean end, so slice a bigger pull into filters that each stay under it. Results can be large, so request only what you need. A successful call returns the endpoint's JSON as a text block; a failure returns its JSON error body with isError set. Use send_feedback to report a bug, request a feature, or pass any feedback to the Blitz team.

tool.name: people_employee_finder
tool.title: Find a company's employees
tool.description: List the current employees of ONE company by seniority/function/geo — no free-text title, paged. Use for a company roster; use people_search for a title/ICP query across companies. Input: `company_linkedin_url` plus flat enum filters (`country_code`, `job_level`, `job_function`; `country_code` defaults to `WORLD` = no geo filter), `max_results`, `page`. Returns: `results` (people, each with name, headline, about, location, LinkedIn URL, connections count, `experiences`, education, skills and certifications; `experiences` holds the job at that company), `results_length`, `page`, `total_pages` and `company_linkedin_url`. No email or phone number is returned; use people_find_work_email or people_find_phone. Cost: 1 record per result.

tool.name: people_search
tool.title: Search people across companies
tool.description: Find people across many companies by ICP filters (firmographic company filters plus person title/level/function/geo; free-text or `[exact]` titles). Use for a title/ICP query spanning companies; for one company's roster use people_employee_finder. Input: `company` and `people` filter blocks, `max_results`, `cursor`. Returns: `results` (people, each with name, headline, about, location, LinkedIn URL, connections count, `experiences`, education, skills and certifications; `experiences` holds the job that matched, not the whole career), `total_results`, `results_length`, `max_results` and a `cursor` for the next page (null at the end). No email or phone number is returned; use people_find_work_email or people_find_phone. Cost: 1 record per result.

tool.name: people_waterfall_icp
tool.title: Find best-fit people at one company by title priority
tool.description: Find the best-fit people at ONE company by priority title tiers (cascade: try tier-1 titles, fall back to tier-2, and so on, stopping at `max_results`). Use when you have ranked title preferences for a single company; use people_employee_finder for a flat roster. Input: `company_linkedin_url` plus an ordered `cascade` of tiers (each with `include_title`/`exclude_title` and a `location`). Returns: `company_linkedin_url`, `results_length` and `max_results` (both the number of people found) and `results`, each with `person` (name, headline, about, location, LinkedIn URL, connections count, `experiences`, education, skills and certifications; `experiences` holds the job that matched), `icp` (the number of the tier that found the person, from 1) and `ranking` (position in the list, from 1). No email or phone number is returned; use people_find_work_email or people_find_phone. Cost: 1 record per result.
